sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Rahul Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
Heard Sri Rahul Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Varun Pratap Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State and also perused the record.
2. At the outset, learned counsel for the applicant has stated that he has filed supplementary affidavit in Registry on 05.04.2024 which is not on record.
3. Office is directed to trace out the said supplementary affidavit and place it on record.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has supplied the photocopy of the said supplementary affidavit and after going through it, this Court has now decided the instant anticipatory bail application.

5. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in F.I.R./Case Crime No. 424 of 2020, under Sections 147, 149, 323, 504, 506, 427, 354-B of IPC, Police Station - Sarai Mamraj, District - Prayagraj, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.
6. As per prosecution story, the applicant is stated to be the medical practitioner at Jan Jeevan Clinic.

The informant and her co-employee Neeraj Pasi are stated to have come for news coverage whereby there are the allegations against the applicant and other co-accused persons of having outraged her modesty and even tried to sexual assault of her on 16.11.2020 at about 03:30 PM.
7. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant is maliciously being prosecuted in the present case due to ulterior motive and has apprehension of his arrest.
Learned counsel has further stated that the FIR is delayed by three days and there is no explanation of the said delay caused.

The injuries in the medical examination report indicates complain of pain only, as such,
there is no visible injury observed by the doctor who conducted the medical examination of the injured person.
Learned counsel has further stated that this is a clear-cut case of applicant as the informant is used to file fake and frivolous FIRs against other persons also.

Learned counsel has stated that the same informant has instituted the FIR/Case Crime No.165 of 2023, u/s 294, 323,
504, 506, 353-A and 376 of IPC, P.S. Saraimamrej, District - Ganganagar (Commissionerate Prayagraj) and FIR No.234 of 2023, u/s 323 & 506 of IPC, P.S. Saraimamrej, District - Ganganagar (Commissionerate Prayagraj).
8.
Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the informant had even filed a complaint with the ADG, Prayagraj on 09.11.2022 alleging a rape case.
The said documents have been annexed as Annexure No.10 to the affidavit filed along with anticipatory bail application.
Learned counsel has further stated that the informant acts at the behest of one Aarti Shukla, who herself has criminal history of 12 cases including the murder cases.
The applicant is a general surgeon and has nothing to do with the said offence as alleged by the prosecution.
He has criminal history of one case i.e. Case Crime No.238 of 2021, u/s 304 of IPC, P.S. Sarai Mamraj, District -Prayagraj wherein closure report has been filed on 02.11.2022.
In case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed, he will not misuse the liberty and shall cooperate with trial.
9. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant.

10. Considering the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicant, the applicant is liable to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in view of the law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi) (2020) 5 SCC 1".

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi) (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The future contingencies regarding the anticipatory bail being granted to applicant shall also be taken care of as per the aforesaid judgment of Apex Court.

sentences.text: Without expressing any opinion upon ultimate merits of the case either ways which may adversely affect the trial of the case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
vi . that the applicant shall appear before the trial court on each date fixed unless personal presence is exempted;
13. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

14. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
